description: Generate truly random numbers in any range — set min, max and count, allow or forbid duplicates, sort the results and copy them.

faqs.a: Yes — enable “unique numbers” and duplicates are excluded (count must fit in the range).
faqs.q: Can I get numbers without duplicates?

faqs.a: Any range from -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000, up to 1,000 numbers per draw.
It uses Math.random(), which is fine for games and drawings but not for cryptography.
One tap copies all results to your clipboard.

howto: Choose how many numbers to draw.
Toggle unique numbers and sorting if needed.
Click Generate, then copy the results.
title: Random Number Generator
